text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: PD-INC-4721 - queue_backlog_high on service=rm-inference-usw2. Severity: P1. Current queue length: 82,431. Avg token latency: 1.8s -> 4.7s. Autoscaler status: failing (quota error). Link: https://pd.example/INC4721

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification: page fired to on-call: @alex

alex: Acked. I'll take it. Quick snapshot?

incident-bot: Logs: `autoscaler-controller` -> `error: node quota exceeded: QuotaExceeded` repeated 12 times last 5m. Scaling attempts: 4, failed:4. Pool: inference-worker-pool-usw2. Current nodes: 12, desired: 60.

maya: I'm on standby to help with traffic shaping. If autoscaler can't increase nodes, we can toggle burst capacity to reserved-pool-2 (if allowed).

alex: Run manual scale to 40 for now. Maya, can you open a capacity override?

maya: Running command:
```
kubectl scale --replicas=40 deploy/inference-worker-pool -n redwood-prod
```
Response: `Error from server (Forbidden): nodes quota exceeded`.

tilly: I'm checking cloud quota. GCP shows GPU quota at 0/48 available for region us-west2. Looks like a quota exhaustion from earlier experiments.

ryan: Noted. I'm going to enable model-fallback route for latency-sensitive customers to serve smaller model (redwood/llama-7b-quant) to reduce token pressure.

alex: How many requests can fallback handle? Any risk to quality?

ryan: Quality tradeoff for a tiny subset (search rerank/test). We'll only route customers flagged in `traffic:latency_sla`.

julie: CS reporting 2 customers noticed timeouts (~30%) hitting chat endpoints. Flagged accounts: acme-inc, finrise. They're in our SLA program.

alex: Good. Tilly, what's ETA on quota increase request?

tilly: I've opened a support ticket with cloud provider and requested emergency quota raise. They acknowledged, ETA 2-4 hours unless expedited.

alex: That's too long. Plan B: drain batch jobs from this pool and move them to low-priority pool. Maya, can you patch the scheduler to prioritize realtime requests?

maya: Patching route table now. Command:
```
POST /admin/routing/policy
{ "pool": "inference-worker-pool-usw2", "priority": "realtime:first, batch:deprioritize" }
```
Applied.

incident-bot: Config change detected by deploy-bot at 2026-03-14T17:06:02Z. No restart required.

ryan: Enabled fallback routing for accounts: [acme-inc, finrise]. Monitoring.

alex: Manual mitigation: reduce per-request max_tokens for non-SLA to 256 to reduce queue growth. Maya set it live?

maya: `feature-flag: non_sla_max_tokens=256` toggled.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by alex. Escalation suspended.

julie: Notifying affected customers with status page note. Drafting now.

tilly: Cloud ticket finally updated: quota increase scheduled but requires account verification. Support asked for billing contact. I'll get that to them.

alex: Timeline check and handoff: I'll stay until we confirm queue < 10k or autoscaler fixed. If not by 20:00 UTC, escalate to SRE on-call first-line (tilly).

ryan: Observability: using console dashboard, queue length fell to 45k after route changes. Token latency down to 2.2s. Still above target.

maya: Batch backlog drain started: moved 18 batch jobs off to low-priority pool. CPU usage for realtime nodes back to 72%.

julie: Status page posted: 'Degraded performance for some hosted inference customers in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress.'

alex: Great. Please keep pings minimal unless customer impact spikes. I'll update PD if edges change.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4721 -> status: acknowledged. active responders: [alex, maya, ryan, tilly, julie].

tilly: Follow-up: I can temporarily assign extra capacity by borrowing from dedicated-reserved-pool-usw2. It will add 10 nodes but needs approval from on-call ops. Alex ok?

alex: Approve. Maya, please route 10 nodes from reserved-pool-2 into inference-worker-pool (hot swap).

maya: Executing:
```
allocator transfer --from reserved-pool-2 --to inference-worker-pool-usw2 --nodes 10
```
Result: success. Nodes added: +10.

ryan: Seeing queue drop to 28k, latency 1.3s. Customer retries dropping.

julie: CS updated customers with new ETA: next update in 30m.

alex: I'll document runbook actions. Tilly, please continue follow-up with billing/contact to get permanent quota.

tilly: Will do. Also we'll file a postmortem: root cause likely large experiment spike + lack of quota guardrails.

alex: Thanks team. Handing off to night shift oncall @maya in 45m — she has runbook and temporary fixes. If autoscaler still failing, escalate back to SRE lead.

maya: Acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor and keep PD ticket open. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed for now, monitoring continues. last update at 3412345732
